results.title: Seven student-related sections prioritised in AUKU repeal, says Zambry
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Seven sections relating to students, including aspects of freedom provided for under the Universities and University Colleges Act (AUKU), will be given priority in the process of repealing the Act, said Higher Education Minister Datuk Seri Dr Zambry Abdul Kadir.

results.title: Your Enemy, The Deep State
results.description: by Doug Casey, Lew Rockwell: Many people would like political solutions to their problems. In other words, they want the government to force others to do what they prefer. results.title: Council rejects free barbecue at Australia Day event after Indigenous board warned it would cause harm
results.description: A Sydney council has voted down plans to expand Australia Day, with concerns it would cause 'potential harm' to Indigenous Australians.
